candidate_models.M2: global plus session term; cold-start and rolling session-anchor predictions are reported separately
candidate_models.M3_FREE: global plus a freely fitted native-to-assigned-slot coefficient
candidate_models.M3_NEG1: global with the native-to-assigned-slot coefficient fixed at -1
candidate_models.M4_NETWORK_SLOT: global plus fixed network terms plus a slot coefficient
candidate_models.M4_SESSION_SLOT: global plus session terms plus a slot coefficient
candidate_models.M4_NETWORK_SESSION: global plus fixed network and session terms
candidate_models.M4_NETWORK_SESSION_SLOT: global plus fixed network and session terms plus a slot coefficient

aggregation.duplicate_rule: Only the owner-frozen canonical reduction contributes to primary independence. Other reductions of the same observation remain in a separate sensitivity registry and inherit the canonical observation fold.
grouping_precedence: exact ordered per-network integer-second T0 vector when complete and at least three distinct T0-vector sessions exist
other provenance-derived initialization/session identity when complete and at least three sessions exist
trusted UTC observing date when at least three date groups exist
aggregation.held_out_strategy: leave one frozen independent group out
aggregation.model_selection: With at least four independent groups, model selection uses only nested training folds. With exactly three groups, every preregistered model is reported but data-driven selection is prohibited.
required_statistics: intrinsic between-beammap scatter after measurement uncertainty
session dependence when session identity is supported
held-out timing prediction error, uncertainty, network/map support counts, and descriptive model structure
aggregation.split_freeze_rule: The freeze stage reads selected-manifest identity and provenance fields only. The run stage refuses a selected-manifest or protocol digest mismatch.
aggregation.timing_outliers: Retain every timing outlier that passes the independently frozen input and fit-quality criteria.

categories.GLOBAL-STABLE: M0 generalizes and persistent network, between-map, interaction, and residual within-observation timing-variation structure are not resolved beyond measurement error.
categories.INSUFFICIENT: The corpus, provenance, independent grouping, retained products, or uncertainty contract cannot support a defensible conclusion.
categories.NETWORK-STABLE: M1 generalizes across independent groups, network terms repeat, and residual map, interaction, and within-observation timing-variation structure are not resolved.
categories.SESSION-STABLE: Only a T0-vector or other provenance-supported rolling anchored session model generalizes, session differences are resolved, and residual within-session timing variation is not.
categories.SLOT-PREDICTABLE: An M3 or slot-containing M4 generalizes on enhanced held-out rows and removes resolved native-phase or slot-related structure; consistency of beta with -1 is reported separately. Favor structural native-time or fractional-slot mitigation, not a physical clock correction.
categories.TIME-VARIABLE: Significant within-observation or within-session timing variation remains after the best supported static or dynamic model. Do not label it clock drift unless raw counters contradict the shared-clock producer account.
categories.UNPREDICTABLE: Variability exceeds measurement uncertainty and no preregistered model predicts held-out results.

decision.tolerance_rule: No arcsecond, beam-FWHM, timing, or mitigation acceptability threshold is part of SCI-ALIGN-001; any on-sky impact translation is deferred to a separate downstream analysis.

core_requires: unambiguous 3C273 source identity under the explicit source regex
detector source-crossing TOD with required identity, slot, signal, flag, and fit fields
output Beammap APT with UID, fit-validity, amplitude, centroid, width, and network identity
telescope trajectory with time, pointing fields, source fields, and Hold
scan registry or realized scan-plan authority
at least three independently accepted left-going and right-going scans
enhanced_requires: unambiguous realized config linkage to every raw network input
raw detector timestamps and producer headers for every analyzed network
proved raw-row linkage under the frozen linkage checks
eligibility.selection_blinding: Eligibility, duplicate resolution, and manifest freezing use provenance and fit-input quality only. They do not inspect inferred timing values.

fit_quality.amplitude: finite and positive retained reference amplitude; fitted direction amplitude is nonnegative
fit_quality.detector_join: UID only; detector row is not persistent identity
fit_quality.model: elliptical two-dimensional Gaussian plus affine background
population: finite retained centroid, amplitude, major FWHM, minor FWHM, and angle
both direction fits pass the same frozen quality criteria
observation-specific preregistration exclusions only where explicitly listed
fit_quality.radial_support: distance from retained full-fit centroid no greater than radial_fwhm_multiplier times retained major FWHM
fit_quality.signal_validity: detector-TOD flag equals zero and signal is finite

identity.source_alias_policy: Preserve every exact source/header representation. Normalize only for the explicit full-match source regex. Conflicting authoritative representations are ambiguous and ineligible.

objective: Determine whether retained 3C273 left/right Beammap timing residuals are globally stable, network-stable, T0-session-stable, native-phase/slot-predictable, time-variable, unpredictable, or insufficient, without designing or authorizing a correction.

producer_authority.authority_status: project-owner-supplied clarification from Kamal during the bounded corpus-tooling task
clock_architecture: NTP supplies the integer-second T0 at each ROACH initialization
all ROACH internal clocks derive from the same Octo-distributed 10 MHz reference
PPS is derived and distributed from the same system
PPS does not reset or restart detector integration/sample cadence
PPS is observed at detector-sample cadence through an incremental counter
the UDP packet carries T0, the incremental PPS counter, and the internal clock counter
the PPS counter is incremented through an interrupt service routine
FPGA source is not presently available
interpretation: arbitrary millisecond NTP epoch error is strongly disfavored; NTP error should primarily affect integer-second labeling
differential oscillator drift is strongly disfavored by the shared 10 MHz reference
shared frequency and PPS do not imply a common detector integration-frame phase
each network may have a distinct but stable integration phase within its realized cadence
the delivered raw D[n]/Ts[n] lineage proof cannot rule out an upstream FPGA metadata-to-integration association error
hypotheses_to_keep_distinct: PPS-counter observation quantized to detector frames
non-atomic or adjacent-frame association among detector data, internal-clock counter, and PPS counter
start, end, centroid, or other timestamp event semantics

determinism: sorted traversal and fixed row/column order
canonical sorted-key JSON with non-finite values rejected
fixed random seed where resampling is used
atomic writes under an owner-specified output root
no wall-clock values in scientific outputs
input, protocol, tool, and selected-manifest digest binding

prohibited: application source or production configuration change
raw-row reassociation claim without direct proof
fixed timing correction recommendation from unpredictable behavior

raw_linkage.assigned_slot_residual: r[i,n] = (t_raw[i,n] + offset[i]) - (phase + round_half_up(((t_raw[i,n] + offset[i]) - phase)/dt) * dt)
raw_linkage.failure_policy: Any ambiguity makes enhanced analysis unavailable for the affected map/network. It does not silently re-associate rows and does not invalidate an otherwise eligible core analysis.
raw_linkage.offset_application: positive-add exactly once before lattice assignment
proof_checks: realized interface identity equals producer RoachIndex
Data.Toltec.Ts row cardinality agrees with retained raw signal row cardinality
producer packet sequence has no unexplained reset, reversal, collision, or gap where available
reconstructed native timestamps are finite and strictly increasing
assigned slots are strictly increasing with no collision or reversal
slot residual magnitude does not exceed one half cadence apart from declared numerical tolerance
every retained science slot has exactly one original native detector row
raw file identity agrees with observation and realized config provenance
raw_linkage.stage_a_boundary: The prior row-lineage proof begins at the delivered raw D[n]/Ts[n] pair. It establishes downstream preservation of that delivered pair but cannot exclude an FPGA-level association error between integration data and metadata.

raw_phase_and_counter_diagnostics.internal_counter_rate_authority: read Header.Toltec.FpgaFreq for each raw file; the counter clock is derived from the shared reference but is not assumed to run at 10 MHz
raw_phase_and_counter_diagnostics.native_frame_phase_estimator: When ordered PpsCount/PpsTime transition pairing is unambiguous, evaluate ((uint32 ClockCount[j] - uint32 PpsTime[j]) mod 2^32) / Header.Toltec.FpgaFreq on the actual PpsTime-transition row j. The PpsCount-transition-row geometry is retained separately and is not called detector-frame phase.
raw_phase_and_counter_diagnostics.phase_failure_policy: If PpsCount/PpsTime transition pairing is ambiguous, report native detector-frame phase unavailable; do not substitute the count-row value or infer metadata-to-integration association.
required_when_fields_are_retained: record the exact integer-second T0 and retained nanosecond field separately for every network; do not reinterpret the nanosecond field as detector phase without authority
form an ordered network-to-T0 vector and use its digest as a candidate ROACH-initialization session identity
record internal-clock and PPS-time counter values on the detector rows immediately before and after every PPS-counter transition
record whether PPS-count and retained PPS-time metadata transition on the same delivered row
measure detector-frame phase by network without assuming a common phase
test phase stability within identical T0-vector sessions and changes across initialization sessions
verify every adjacent PPS transition spacing is 122 or 123 detector rows
verify transition row i+128 minus transition row i equals 15625 detector rows wherever support exists
test internal-clock increments modulo 2^32 against the retained accumulation length
search packet, internal-clock, PPS-count, and PPS-time sequences for one-row discontinuity or variable metadata-capture/ISR latency
regress left/right network timing against measured native phase and native-to-assigned-slot residual, including the preregistered slope -1 comparison

nw9_pps_time_increment_anomaly.detector: For every available network, compare each consecutive delivered PpsTime transition increment with authenticated Header.Toltec.FpgaFreq; missing metadata is unavailable, never zero anomalies.
nw9_pps_time_increment_anomaly.occurrence: Report eligible-increment denominator, mismatch count/rate, signed and absolute tick residuals, physical-time conversion, first/last row, isolated/consecutive classification, PPS-counter row geometry, packet and detector-row geometry, by observation/network/T0 session and corpus controls.
nw9_pps_time_increment_anomaly.consequence: At each mismatch preserve the delivered row and adjacent-row counter/timestamp geometry. Distinguish one-field metadata inconsistency, delivered reconstructed timestamp perturbation, persistent subsequent delivered-field offset, and unresolved adjacent-row association. No FPGA metadata-to-integration association is inferred.
nw9_pps_time_increment_anomaly.timing: For each observation with nw9, report nw9 timing, nw9 minus other-network timing, all-network and leave-nw9-out pooled timing, their covariance-aware uncertainty, and the change. Across observations fit a preregistered uncertainty-aware nw9 anomaly-rate association; it is not causal.
nw9_pps_time_increment_anomaly.affected_row_sensitivity: No row mask or repair is authorized unless a future protocol establishes unambiguous metadata semantics. Leave-nw9-out is the preregistered interpretable sensitivity.

raw_phase_and_counter_diagnostics.variation_language: First-half/second-half or fitted time slopes are within-observation timing variation. Call them clock drift only if raw counter evidence contradicts the shared-clock account.

scan_classifier.direction_measurement: central 80 percent of each admitted compatibility-science window
scan_classifier.hold: both adjacent native TelescopeBackend Hold words are finite integral zero and equal; transitions or ambiguity are excluded
scan_classifier.low_speed_threshold: low_speed_fraction_of_minimum times the minimum absolute robust median projected speed over admitted windows
scan_classifier.positive_axis: principal eigenvector of admitted-window median realized velocity vectors, signed toward configured Map.ScanAngle

timing_models.common_support: The primary population is the exact intersection of original signal/flag/radial/Hold validity and valid interior raw-row/slot/telescope support for every compared basis, row guard, and phase. Native-only support is secondary and scan-edge population changes cannot count as improvement.
timing_models.counterfactual_warning: k=+1 is a diagnostic comparison, not evidence of a row defect or an authorized correction.
timing_models.physical_timestamp_semantics: start/end/centroid semantics and FPGA metadata-to-integration association remain unresolved
timing_models.sample_cadence_authority: realized alignment provenance; 0.008192 s is the expected 148670 regression value but is not hard-coded for corpus identity

controls: left/right amplitude or within-observation amplitude ratio
fit quality, sample counts, detector counts, and exclusions
uncertainty_and_controls.jackknife_population: selected left/right stable scans only; excluded scans never create no-op replicates
uncertainty_and_controls.time_segments: beginning, middle, and end raw slot residuals plus first-half and second-half Beammap timing estimates
